outcome: lesion characteristics (texture, consistency, vascularity, resistive index, elastography)
cohort: 32 female patients in Baghdad governorate who had undergone at least one Cesarean section and were diagnosed with abdominal wall endometriosis by postoperative histopathology
finding: Ultrasound characteristics combined with clinical features and symptoms are an excellent preoperative imaging modality for diagnosing abdominal wall endometriosis, excluding other lesions, and accurately assessing muscle invasion for surgical planning.
